categories.main_business_segments: Hybio Pharmaceutical primarily operates in four core business segments: peptide formulations, peptide active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), small nucleic acids, and CDMO/CMO services. The company focuses on both generic and innovative drugs, with a strong emphasis on peptide drugs and expanding its global presence through international registrations and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced peptide synthesis technologies including fully automated peptide synthesizers, microwave peptide synthesis, and large-scale purification systems. It adheres strictly to GMP standards across multiple jurisdictions (US FDA, EU, Australia, Brazil, Indonesia, China) and employs proprietary cost-reduction and efficiency-enhancing technologies for peptide production. The R&D platform integrates AI and biotechnologies to accelerate drug development and clinical trials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hybio serves pharmaceutical companies, distributors with direct sales teams, and medical institutions domestically and internationally. Its key markets include the US, Europe, Asia, South America, and the Middle East, with a growing share of overseas revenue driven by peptide formulations and APIs, especially GLP-1 related products. The company also provides contract development and manufacturing services to global biotech and pharma clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shenzhen and subsidiaries in Wuhan, Gansu, Dali, and Hong Kong. It has expanded its footprint internationally with subsidiaries and business activities in the United States, Germany, and other global markets. Overseas sales accounted for over 50% of total revenue in 2024, highlighting its global market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hybio operates both upstream and midstream in the pharmaceutical supply chain. It produces active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and develops finished peptide formulations. Additionally, it offers CDMO/CMO services, covering contract development and manufacturing from raw materials to finished dosage forms, positioning itself as an integrated supplier in the peptide drug industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on talent development, innovation combining generic and innovative drugs, and internationalization. R&D priorities include advancing peptide and small nucleic acid drugs, expanding clinical trials, and accelerating regulatory approvals globally. It invests heavily in AI integration for drug discovery and clinical trial efficiency, with key pipeline projects targeting diabetes, obesity, and oncology indications.
categories.revenue_model: Hybio generates revenue primarily through product sales of peptide formulations and APIs, both domestically and internationally. It also earns income from contract development and manufacturing services (CDMO/CMO), including fees for product development and commercial production. The company uses a mix of direct sales, distribution partnerships, and licensing agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hybio is positioned as a leading domestic peptide drug manufacturer with significant international recognition, notably as the first non-originator company to receive FDA approval for liraglutide in the US. It competes with other pharmaceutical firms in the peptide and generic drug sectors, leveraging its advanced technology, extensive product pipeline, and global regulatory certifications to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hybio reported revenues of approximately RMB 590 million, a 36.82% increase year-over-year, driven by strong overseas sales growth. Despite ongoing net losses, the company significantly reduced its losses compared to prior years and improved cash flow from operations. The company has total assets of about RMB 3 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, reflecting a growth-oriented profile with expanding international market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hybio emphasizes its comprehensive peptide drug development and manufacturing capabilities, advanced proprietary technologies, and strict quality control systems certified by multiple international regulatory bodies. Its unique value lies in integrating peptide APIs and formulations with CDMO/CMO services, enabling efficient global market access. The company’s pioneering FDA approvals and broad product pipeline in innovative peptides and small nucleic acids differentiate it as a high-quality, innovation-driven pharmaceutical provider.
